automaticArrival.input: No pointer or keyboard input before scene readiness and settlement.

scene.percentileCalculation: Nearest-rank percentile: sort ascending and select index max(0, ceil(p × n) - 1).

globalScheduler.percentileCalculation: Nearest-rank percentile: sort ascending and select index max(0, ceil(p × n) - 1).

desktopSceneFrameWorkload.gpuRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1, Unspecified Version)
desktopSceneFrameWorkload.method: Nearest-rank p95 of main-thread CPU duration measured immediately around renderer.render during 10 seconds of bounded trusted pointer input. This measures CPU submission workload, not GPU completion.

activeSceneRenderCadence.method: Nearest-rank p95 between consecutive renders within active interpolation bursts; inactive event-driven gaps reset the interval chain and are excluded.

labInteractionLatency.label: Lab interaction-latency proxy from trusted Playwright mouse/keyboard input and PerformanceEventTiming; not field INP.
labInteractionLatency.input: Trusted Playwright mouse click followed by keyboard Tab.
labInteractionLatency.target: Diagnostic only; field INP remains unmeasured.

residualGaps: Physical Safari, iOS Safari, and Android Chrome were not exercised by this harness.
Headless SwiftShader evidence does not replace physical-device GPU and frame-time review.
Lighthouse mobile throttling is simulated and must be identified as such in review.
The scene workload is a main-thread CPU submission measurement around renderer.render, not GPU completion time or a DevTools trace.
Global headless requestAnimationFrame cadence is retained as a non-gating scheduler diagnostic.
The lab interaction measurement uses trusted Playwright input and Event Timing when supported; it is not field INP.
